# Add this near the top level of .github/workflows/aq26-weekly-production.yml,
# alongside "on:", "jobs:", etc. It prevents two weekly-production runs
# pushing to main at the same time.
concurrency:
  group: aq26-weekly-production-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

# In the checkout step, use fetch-depth: 0:
- name: Checkout repository
  uses: actions/checkout@v4
  with:
    fetch-depth: 0

# Replace the existing fragile commit step with this:
- name: Commit generated weekly operational files
  if: always()
  run: |
    set -euo pipefail
    python scripts/aq26_safe_commit_generated_outputs.py
